access-flag-exceptions.name: Access Flag Exceptions
access-flag-exceptions.description: Join check-ins to the access-flag export. List denies that walked, allows that the freeze log would question, and overrides they recorded.

check-in-day.name: Check In Day
check-in-day.description: Build today's check-in list from their scan export.

class-roster.name: Class Roster
class-roster.description: Build the roster for named classes from the schedule file plus check-ins or bookings they exported.

failed-draft-list.name: Failed Draft List
failed-draft-list.description: List failed drafts from the membership or billing export they dropped: amount as printed, fail date, and reason code if present.

freeze-and-cancel-list.name: Freeze And Cancel List
freeze-and-cancel-list.description: List open freezes and pending cancels from their freeze log and membership export.

guest-pass-log.name: Guest Pass Log
guest-pass-log.description: Build the guest-pass log from check-ins plus the membership export for host rows if their file requires a host.

missing-waivers.name: Missing Waivers
missing-waivers.description: Compare the membership export to the waiver folder. List members and guests whose required form is absent.

pt-session-counts.name: PT Session Counts
pt-session-counts.description: Tabulate purchased, used, and remaining PT sessions from their package sheet.

retail-close.name: Retail Close
retail-close.description: Close retail from their count-and-price sheet plus the day-close tender export.
